purpose: We are developing an algorithm that flags undiagnosed high blood pressure from smartwatch data. To validate it clinically we need individual systolic readings of patients with a hypertension diagnosis; summary numbers cannot be used to validate a classifier.
question: Provide pseudonymised systolic blood pressure measurements for adults with hypertension.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Cohort = adults with hypertension who have at least one systolic blood pressure value (LOINC 8480-6).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
